methodology_note: AI-assisted review verified by two team reviewers (TV1: VŨ THỊ LOAN, TV2: MAI HẢI YẾN). Both sheets verify the same AI-assisted draft; agreement between TV1 and TV2 is not reported as independent inter-annotator agreement or Cohen kappa.
limitation: Internal human-verified AI-assisted review, not expert gold. In-scope precision counts only B in {SVA, VFORM, NNUM} (10 cases); all-B precision includes 3 out-of-scope (Khác) and 1 undetermined-tense case. Upper bound assumes every C is a true target error; not a confidence interval.
